description: This PHP class defines a collection of attribute sets used by an HTML purifier module. It manages extensions, inclusions, and identifier expansion for attribute collections.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrCollections
classes.description: A class managing attribute collections with support for extensions, inclusions, and identifier expansion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the attribute collection, performing setup and extension loading.

methods.name: doConstruct
methods.description: Performs the detailed setup of attribute collections, including module extensions and expansions.

methods.name: performInclusions
methods.description: Merges included attribute collections into the current collection, handling recursion and avoiding cycles.

methods.name: expandIdentifiers
methods.description: Replaces string identifiers with actual attribute objects using an AttrTypes instance.
